A program I made to download the [[Gaiad]] genealogy in gedcom form.

By default it exports a forest family tree from {{q|q1}} and {{q|q3}} of 1500 individuals. This gives roughly the full prehuman portion of the Gaiad.

Future functionality we are looking at is the ability to take an existing gedcom file as an argument so that if a person say had Charlemagne as an ancestor, they could make the tree branch off from Charlemagne. Going to Aster and Andromeda.
